parameters.jsCode: const required=['store_domain','session_id','actor_id','correlation_id','message'];for(const key of required){if(!$json[key])throw new Error(`${key} is required`);}const raw=String($json.message);const secretPatterns=[/sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g,/password\s*[:=]\s*\S+/gi,/access[_ -]?token\s*[:=]\s*\S+/gi,/api[_ -]?key\s*[:=]\s*\S+/gi,/\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,19}\b/g];let redacted=raw;for(const pattern of secretPatterns)redacted=redacted.replace(pattern,'[REDACTED]');const allowedKinds=new Set(['WORKING','ENTITY','SEMANTIC','EPISODIC','PROCEDURAL','APPROVAL']);const candidates=(Array.isArray($json.memory_candidates)?$json.memory_candidates:[]).slice(0,50).map(item=>({kind:allowedKinds.has(item.kind)?item.kind:'SEMANTIC',status:item.status==='VERIFIED'?'VERIFIED':'PROPOSED',resource_type:String(item.resource_type || 'conversation'),resource_id:item.resource_id?String(item.resource_id):null,memory_key:String(item.memory_key || 'statement').slice(0,200),content:item.content && typeof item.content==='object'?item.content:{text:String(item.content || '')},source_type:String(item.source_type || 'conversation'),source_id:String(item.source_id || $json.correlation_id),source_observed_at:item.source_observed_at || new Date().toISOString(),confidence:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(item.confidence ?? 0.5))),sensitivity:String(item.sensitivity || 'INTERNAL')}));return [{json:{...$json,message:redacted,memory_candidates:candidates,memory_candidates_json:JSON.stringify(candidates),redactions_applied:redacted!==raw}}];

WITH selected_store AS (
  SELECT id FROM stores WHERE shop_domain = $1 AND active = true
), upsert_conversation AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (store_id, external_session_id, actor_id, channel, updated_at)
  SELECT id, $2, $3, $4, now() FROM selected_store
  ON CONFLICT (store_id, external_session_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now(), actor_id = EXCLUDED.actor_id
  RETURNING id, store_id
), stored_message AS (
  INSERT INTO conversation_messages (store_id, conversation_id, correlation_id, role, content, selected_agent_key, intent, risk_level)
  SELECT store_id, id, $5, $6, $7, NULLIF($8,''), NULLIF($9,''), NULLIF($10,'') FROM upsert_conversation
  ON CONFLICT (store_id, correlation_id, role) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), candidate_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($11::jsonb) AS c(kind text, status text, resource_type text, resource_id text, memory_key text, content jsonb, source_type text, source_id text, source_observed_at timestamptz, confidence numeric, sensitivity text)
), stored_memory AS (
  INSERT INTO memory_items (store_id, kind, status, resource_type, resource_id, memory_key, content, source_type, source_id, source_observed_at, confidence, sensitivity, content_hash, created_by, verified_by, verified_at)
  SELECT s.id, c.kind::memory_kind, c.status::memory_status, c.resource_type, c.resource_id, c.memory_key, c.content, c.source_type, c.source_id, c.source_observed_at, c.confidence, c.sensitivity, encode(digest(c.content::text, 'sha256'),'hex'), $3, CASE WHEN c.status='VERIFIED' THEN $3 ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN c.status='VERIFIED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
  FROM selected_store s CROSS JOIN candidate_rows c
  ON CONFLICT (store_id, resource_type, memory_key, content_hash) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM upsert_conversation) AS conversation_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM stored_message) AS messages_written, (SELECT count(*) FROM stored_memory) AS memories_written;
